domain: platformization of a multi-agent autonomous software engineering studio — deployment topology, harness strategy, memory, model management, role packs, quality gates
topology_of_pass: 6 parallel isolated research agents (memory, docker/topology/OAuth, pi ecosystem, LLM gateways, 3 reference projects, quality gates) -> dialectic synthesis
entities: Deployment Unit (native daemon + optional containerized worker tier; Tauri is a client, not the runtime)
Harness Distro (host-detected or manager-installed CLI harness + per-lane config dir + auth material)
Auth Material by kind: api_key | oauth | local | cli_delegated | cloud_iam (cli_delegated = harness owns OAuth, we meter)
Named Volume per class (studio-state, studio-evidence, studio-logs, studio-harness, studio-toolchains) + host-identical bind mounts for repos/worktrees
Model Fabric (in-process unified client: anthropic-messages / openai-completions / openai-responses; cost{input,output,cacheRead,cacheWrite})
Connection -> Pool -> RoleSlot (roles name slots, never providers; sticky-per-task affinity)
RolePack (multi-harness: agents/*.md + skills/*/SKILL.md + MCP slice + rules + tool manifest + rolepack.lock + model-slot bindings)
Frozen-Candidate Evidence Gate (freeze -> risk tier -> lens depth -> one bounded correction -> acknowledge + BURN; burn is what merge queue requires)
Action Registry + Surface Exposure Matrix (direct vs discoverable; per-surface allow/ask)
Non-Escalating Child Session (reject, never downgrade) + 12-field spawn policy
Diagnostic Broker (CLI diagnostics -> SARIF 2.1.0 -> severity budget on NEW findings -> agent_prompt fix-tasks)
Anti-circumvention Guard (command hooks + marker-file freshness + CODEOWNERS on gate configs + no in-source suppressions)
Memory as Rebuildable Ledger Projection (typed temporal facts keyed to plan-ledger hashes + budgeted <=250-token anchored summaries)
constraints: local-first: code and OAuth material stay on user hardware by default
agents never see raw OAuth tokens — capability handles only (roles/SecretBroker already ships the shape)
OAuth subscriptions (Claude Pro/Max, ChatGPT Plus/Codex, Copilot) fit ONLY via harness delegation — Anthropic prohibits third-party harness use of Claude Pro/Max [VERIFIED opencode.ai/docs/providers]
worktrees live on the host at host-identical paths; the engine owns all git worktree add/lock/prune; never inside an image layer
memory is a projection over the event-sourced ledger, never a second source of truth
write path denies anything derivable from the repo/git/ledger/receipts
vector index stays opt-in with mandatory reranker; L0-L3 first
quality gates are process-level and fail-closed; prompt rules are advisory only
suppressing a finding requires a SARIF suppression with justification owned by CODEOWNERS, never an in-source ignore
budget arms on input+output+cache_write; cache_read excluded
auto-routing forbidden on coder.primary and reviewer (review independence / error correlation)
no marketplace, cloud-hosting, mobile, or voice scope (roadmap boundary)

key_empirical_facts.swe_contextbench: Oracle Summary Learning 34.34% vs No-Context 26.26% (+8.1pt) at 217-token summaries; Free Context Learning 26.26% at +27% cost (no gain); Free Summary Learning 22.22% (WORSE than no memory) [arXiv 2602.08316]
key_empirical_facts.mem0_is_add_only: Mem0 Apr-2026 algorithm is explicitly no UPDATE/DELETE — accumulate-only; scored worst of 4 frameworks (24.24%) on coding benchmark [github.com/mem0ai/mem0 + arXiv 2602.08316]
key_empirical_facts.no_production_deletion_path: Every major agent memory framework has production-grade write+retrieval; none has production-grade deletion [zylos.ai controlled-forgetting]
key_empirical_facts.macos_bind_mount_tax: Docker Desktop virtiofs bind mounts ~3x slower than native on macOS; Mutagen sync 59% faster but paid [paolomainardi.com 2025]
key_empirical_facts.claude_code_keychain_split_brain: macOS Keychain is authoritative over ~/.claude/.credentials.json and the two can diverge; no RFC 8628 device-code flow [anthropics/claude-code#91180 #91158 #44028]
key_empirical_facts.anthropic_prohibits_third_party_harness: OpenCode removed bundled Claude Pro/Max plugins in 1.3.0 because 'Anthropic explicitly prohibits this' [opencode.ai/docs/providers]
key_empirical_facts.agent_hook_bypass: Claude Code bypassed pre-commit via --no-verify, git stash, quiet flags, core.hooksPath override, GitHub MCP write tools — 6 consecutive commits with failing tests despite explicit CLAUDE.md rules [anthropics/claude-code#40117]
key_empirical_facts.lefthook_broken_in_worktrees: lefthook fails to install in linked worktrees (issue #901); buffered output can OOM under multi-agent fan-out. Use prek (or betterhook) instead
key_empirical_facts.opencode_lsp_advice: OpenCode docs: 'In many projects it is better to have the agent run lint, typecheck, or other diagnostic CLI tools directly' — LSP is off by default in OpenCode and absent in Claude Code
key_empirical_facts.sarif_level_optional: result.level is optional in SARIF 2.1.0; CodeQL omits it and uses rule.defaultConfiguration.level — naive error filters pass on a repo full of errors
key_empirical_facts.pi_is_refusal_plus_packaging: base pi ships 4 tools and explicitly refuses MCP/subagents/permissions/plan-mode; distribution is a one-keyword npm 'pi-package' manifest. 110,563 stars
key_empirical_facts.rolepacks_are_the_market: gsd-core ships 36 specialists + 72 skills across 9+ harnesses incl. pi adapter; wshobson/agents 40,004 stars; 5 of top ~45 pi.dev packages are role/subagent systems
key_empirical_facts.omp_ingests_opencode_at_priority_55: oh-my-pi discovery providers ingest 15 foreign config formats with OpenCode at priority 55 — asymmetry that decides the substrate bet [review/oh-my-pi/docs/config-usage.md]
key_empirical_facts.vibe_kanban_sunset: BloopAI/vibe-kanban (28.2k stars) is sunsetting — market signal that pure kanban-over-agents is not a sustainable product
key_empirical_facts.flawfinder_not_fallow: No static-analysis tool named 'fallaw'/'fallow' exists; intended tool is almost certainly Flawfinder (C/C++ only, GPL-2.0+) — irrelevant for a Rust/TS stack
key_empirical_facts.unify_pivoted_away: unify.ai is no longer an LLM router as of Sep 2026 — now a continual-learning research lab

decisions.Q1_memory: No product fits. Pattern = Claude Code write-path deny-list + Graphiti bi-temporal supersession + Codex two-phase consolidation/forgetting, composed as a rebuildable projection over our own event-sourced ledger. Shipped Ladder L0-L4 is VALIDATED; gaps are (a) code-derivability deny-list, (b) validity windows keyed to plan-ledger hash chain, (c) <=250-token (path,symbol,commit_sha)-anchored summaries. Never adopt a memory product as source of truth.
decisions.Q2_topology: Hybrid: native control plane (studio-core in/alongside Tauri) + optional disposable containerized workers. Docker-only fails macOS Metal GPU + OAuth keychain + 3x git tax + Docker Desktop license. Desktop-only fails containment of agent-written code.
decisions.Q3_harness: Detect-then-install hybrid. BYO host harness is the default path (zero OAuth rework). Manager installs only what is missing into host-side versioned ~/.studio/harness/bin/<name>/<ver>/. Never prebake harness CLIs into images (ToS/license + update skew + OAuth death). Per-lane config dirs; SecretBroker mints short-TTL access tokens.
decisions.Q4_persistence: One named volume per class (state/evidence/logs/harness/toolchains) + host-identical bind mounts for repos and .worktrees. PRAGMA user_version forward-only migrations with VACUUM INTO backup + /state/.layout-version stamp. Engine owns all git ops. Worktrees never live in an image layer.
decisions.Q5_forgo_byo_agent: Yes — that is the RolePack layer. Split by auth kind: API keys / OpenCode Zen / local ride the Model Fabric; OAuth subscriptions MUST ride harness delegation (cli_delegated) via ACP. Both feed the same role slots.
decisions.Q6_model_management: Hybrid: in-process Rust Model Fabric + credential store (discovery over configuration) + Connection->Pool->RoleSlot. External gateways (LiteLLM/OpenRouter/OmniRoute/BiFrost/Requesty/Vercel/Cloudflare) are provider profiles, never required. Pinned tiers default (three onboarding profiles: Max-first / API-cheap / Local-only). Auto-routing opt-in per slot, forbidden on coder.primary and reviewer. Honest 4-state connect UI with live ping proof. OmniRoute is the strongest integration candidate and is already running in this workspace.
decisions.Q7_pi_vs_opencode: Yes build RolePacks — the market's center of gravity. Multi-harness pack authored against oh-my-pi's AgentDefinition (typed output schema, spawns, autoloadSkills, role-aliased models, omp --profile isolation); emit omp drop + base-pi package.json#pi shim + .opencode/agents/ mirror. oh-my-pi wins capability, base pi wins distribution, OpenCode wins mindshare. Bind to omp AgentDefinition not bare ExtensionAPI (base pi may absorb subagents/MCP and collapse the third-party market).
decisions.Q8_steal_list: 1 gentle-ai frozen-candidate + burned authority (extend to gate DELIVERY, which they refused) 2 happier action registry + surface exposure matrix 3 happier non-escalating child sessions (reject not downgrade) 4 kasetto lockfile-first content-hash asset sync 5 gentle-ai deterministic next-transition owned by daemon 6 happier canonical tool normalization 7 kasetto managed blocks 8 kasetto bind-time secret placeholders 9 gentle-ai proportional routing. Also: beads (typed DAG as claimable work), vibe-kanban sunset as market signal.
decisions.Q9_skills_mcp_per_profile: Lockfile-pinned asset manifests (kasetto model): 4 asset kinds (skills, commands, MCPs, instructions) from one source, transformed per agent, content-hashed into rolepack.lock, --locked in CI. Combine with existing compile-checked tool manifests + per-role schema token cost scoreboard. Secrets resolved at bind time via SecretBroker, never written to lock or agent settings.
decisions.Q10_quality_gates: Defense in depth, process-level, SARIF-shaped. prek (NOT lefthook) for git hooks. CLI diagnostics as the authoritative gate (LSP is a navigation aid behind a broker). Severity budget blocks NEW error-level findings only. Anti-circumvention: command deny-hooks (--no-verify, core.hooksPath, HUSKY=0/SKIP=*, stash+commit, gate-config writes), block GitHub MCP write-throughs, marker-file freshness, CODEOWNERS on gate configs, suppressions only as SARIF objects with justification, CI runs with ignores disabled, agent creds read-only for CI, full Bash audit log. 'fallaw' = Flawfinder, C/C++ only — skip.

next_phase_workstreams: WS1 Fabric substrate (BLOCKING): real auth-material subsystem (keychain bridge, token materialization, refresh lifecycle — currently only profile_dir + SecretBroker mint/redeem stub), Model Fabric, Connection/Pool/RoleSlot store
WS2 Contract runtime (the moat): frozen-candidate gate extended to delivery, deterministic next-transition, non-escalating spawn policy, action registry
WS3 Content proof (one pack, not fifty): flagship RolePack on omp AgentDefinition, lockfile-pinned, 3 targets, Diagnostic Broker as quality spine
experimental_hypotheses: H-A [HYPOTHESIS: write path with code-derivability deny-list + <=250-token (path,symbol,commit_sha)-anchored summaries raises resolved-rate >=5 absolute points over no-memory, while raw prior trajectories move it <=1pt and raise cost >=20%]. Kill: <2pt lift -> cut Rung 3 to plain MEMORY.md

H-B [HYPOTHESIS: frozen-candidate review with one bounded correction + burned ack reduces review->fix->re-review loops >=50% vs live-worktree review on 20 tasks, no drop in defect catch]. Kill: <25% reduction or catch drop >5%

H-C [HYPOTHESIS: one RolePack source compiled to omp/base-pi/opencode scores within 5% of omp-native on role-fidelity (tool-surface adherence, structured-yield validity, cross-role leakage) across a 6-role benchmark]. Kill: >15% trail -> omp sole substrate

LM2 spike: 30 sessions, OpenCode lsp:true vs LSP-off + PostToolUse CLI hooks -> fix success, diagnostics-per-token, wall-clock, peak RSS
LM3 spike: cache_read/(input+cache_write) and USD/completed-task on >=30-turn coder sessions, sticky vs least-cost-per-request routing
FV2 spike: Claude Code ACP adapter on Max subscription vs API key USD cost on real refactors; test billed_kind flip predicts the 5-hour-quota crossover
rejected_convergences: adopt Mem0/Letta/Supermemory as source of truth (second history; Mem0 is ADD-only and worst-in-class on coding)
Docker Compose as the product (breaks macOS OAuth + Metal GPU, 3x git tax, license wall)
prebake harness CLIs into images (ToS + update skew + OAuth death)
auto-route models for cost (dialect churn, cache-cold hops, reviewer correlation)
build our own LSP layer as the gate (OpenCode's own docs recommend against)
